# Additional resources

The following resources were used as references and sources of inspiration when developing this tutorial. They also provide opportunities for further learning.

[Official Git documentation](https://git-scm.com/docs){target="_blank"} - Official reference documentation for Git commands, configuration settings, and other features.

[Pro Git](https://git-scm.com/book/en/v2){target="_blank"} - A comprehensive, freely available book covering Git from basic concepts to advanced features.

[Atlassian Git tutorials](https://www.atlassian.com/git){target="_blank"} - Tutorials explaining Git concepts and workflows, with practical examples.

[Boot.dev: Learn Git](https://www.boot.dev/courses/learn-git){target="_blank"} - An interactive course covering introductory and intermediate Git concepts.

[Boot.dev: Learn Git 2](https://www.boot.dev/courses/learn-git-2){target="_blank"} - An interactive course covering more advanced Git concepts and collaborative workflows.

[Git Exercises](https://gitexercises.fracz.com){target="_blank"} - Interactive exercises for practicing Git commands and solving common Git problems.
